data.title: bn-1qvr: tokio worker comm is tokio-rt-worker
data.description: Update stale tokio worker thread comm 'tokio-runtime-w' -> 'tokio-rt-worker' across profile_adapters, evidence_schema, runner self-test, and fixtures. tokio 1.48+ default changed (verified in tokio-1.50.0 builder.rs:291). Overlay sets no thread_name -> uses default. unittest 46/46, runner 163/163, verifier 187/187, evaluator SELF_TEST_PASS.

data.reason: APPROVED. Verified against tokio source: tokio-1.50.0/src/runtime/builder.rs:291 default thread_name is 'tokio-rt-worker' (rustdoc line 519 'The default name is tokio-rt-worker'), and the overlay builders (public/main.rs) set no .thread_name so they inherit it. Observed runtime threads (guard /proc/comm) confirm 'tokio-rt-worker'. All 7 occurrences updated (both constants + runner self-test + 3 fixtures); comm is 15 chars, within TASK_COMM_LEN. All suites green. open_findings=0
